moments.evidence: Una galeta sencera reposa sobre una vora baixa dins d’un plat. L’empremta de la galeta és una línia diagonal.
Prem les dues puntes amb els dits, deixant el centre sobre la vora baixa. La galeta s’esquerda just al centre.
Els dos fragments són dins del plat amb la línia diagonal interrompuda. Les engrunes queden entre tots dos.

continuity.anchor: Una sola galeta repartida en dos trossos i les seves engrunes.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Synthetic photorealistic studio photography with one natural young adult woman with realistic skin, clothing, anatomy, grip and reach. The actor has tan skin and brown curls. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Una galeta sencera reposa sobre una vora baixa dins d’un plat. L’empremta de la galeta és una línia diagonal. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Prem les dues puntes amb els dits, deixant el centre sobre la vora baixa. La galeta s’esquerda just al centre. RIGHT result: Els dos fragments són dins del plat amb la línia diagonal interrompuda. Les engrunes queden entre tots dos. Continuity and accounting: Una sola galeta repartida en dos trossos i les seves engrunes. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image. Specific production fix: Use a matte plain oval dish with ONE raised rigid narrow ceramic support block at the center, plainly separate and visible in all three panels under the same long single cookie. True side camera slightly above plate rim to see center contact and room under both ends. The cookie initially bridges the raised support on its center with its ends hovering. In middle the two index fingertips PRESS DOWN on the two outer ends causing cookie to visibly bend around the raised block and crack right over it, ends lower than center. No fingers lifting outer ends. Last same two pieces and crumb over the support, exact shape and strip on cookie.
attempts.review: El suport sota el centre es manté i la pressió de tots dos índexs trenca la galeta exactament a sobre seu. Les meitats i les engrunes queden al plat.
